facts.fact: A duplicate driving licence is issued when the licence is lost or destroyed
facts.quote: A duplicate driving licence will be issued in the following circumstances When the licence is lost or destroyed

facts.fact: Apply online on sarathi.parivahan.gov.in: select the State, then 'Services on Drivers License (Renewal/Duplicate/AEDL/Others)' in the Driving License menu, fill the form and proceed
facts.quote: What will be the process of Drivers License renewal/Duplicate? Steps follow to apply for RENEWAL of License :- 1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/ 2. Select concerned state 3. Click on "Services on Drivers License(Renewal/Duplicate/AEDL/Others)" from "Driving License" menu 4. Fill up application form

facts.fact: Documents: application in Form 2, an attested photocopy of the DL if available (for a lost licence), and the prescribed fee with user charges
facts.quote: Requirements Application in Form 2 Original licence written or defaced if available. Attested photocopies of DL if available in case of loss of licence. Fees as prescribed along with user charges

behaviour: Replies in Hindi; explains the duplicate DL application on Sarathi (sarathi.parivahan.gov.in) and the documents needed, citing Parivahan/Sarathi.
fail_if: Sends the user to an agent or a non-government site for the duplicate licence.
summary: Added duplicate-DL grounds and documents (Parivahan Duplicate Licence page) and the Sarathi application path (Parivahan FAQ).
